A little help. A lot of heart.

A few helpful answers.

Straight answers about the project, its privacy goals and release status.

01

Is TidyTroupe available now?

This repository contains a development project. No public Amazon listing or launch date has been supplied.

02

Will chores work offline?

Offline core household management is the design goal. Speech recognition can depend on installed services and a network.

03

Can children use a Fire tablet?

A simplified child task view is part of the design. Physical Fire tablet validation remains a release requirement.

04

Does it sync across devices?

No cross-device sync service is configured. Do not assume another tablet can see local household records.

05

Which languages are available?

Nineteen app locales are targeted. Translations, human review and localised screenshots remain pending; the app, store and speech language lists are separate.
